# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 57 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40-41 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_057_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 57

**1** Jesus said: "The kingdom of the Father is like a person who had good seed.

**2** His enemy came by night and sowed weeds among the good seed.

**3** The person did not allow them to pull up the weeds; he said, 'I am afraid that you might go to pull up the weeds and pull up the wheat along with them.'

**4** For on the day of the harvest the weeds will be plainly visible, and they will be pulled up and burned."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Kingdom of the Father" — the full title
- "Sowed weeds among the good seed" — the deliberate contamination by night
- "I am afraid that you might" — the master's caution; the wheat is at risk from premature action
- "Plainly visible" — revelation language; the day of harvest makes what was hidden plain
- No allegorical interpretation follows in Thomas; the parable stands alone

---
